efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Moilanen 2015; study numbers and first-use year (2009, study 09000124) from the FDA multidisciplinary review of NDA 212099.
efficacy.judgement: First use proxied by the sponsor study number 09000124 in the FDA review; first public in Moilanen 2015.
efficacy.note: Darolutamide slowed VCaP xenograft growth in orchidectomised mice and delayed regrowth after castration (sponsor study 09000124).
efficacy.quote: In addition, ODM-201 reduces the growth of AR-overexpressing VCaP prostate cancer cells both in vitro and in a castration-resistant VCaP xenograft model.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: xenograft growth inhibition vs 12-week PSA response
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. The FDA review adds that in the castration-resistant VCaP study (1010TM03) PSA fell at all doses but the tumour-growth trend was not statistically significant, so the model's own signal was modest.
efficacy.judgement: ARADES (Fizazi 2014) phase 2 primary endpoint was 12-week PSA response, a surrogate; ARAMIS (2019, MFS HR 0.41) is the outcome trial, so outcome_tested positive. Dated 2015, when the model side became public.
efficacy.note: Paper sets the castration-resistant VCaP xenograft result beside phase 1/2 activity in CRPC; ARADES phase 2: 29-33% PSA response at 12 weeks; ARAMIS later positive.
efficacy.short: Xenograft activity matched ARADES PSA responses
efficacy.quote: We report here the pharmacological profile of ODM-201, a novel AR inhibitor that showed significant antitumor activity and a favorable safety profile in phase 1/2 studies in men with CRPC.

patient_trials.quote: 11 (29%) patients in the 200 mg group, 13 (33%) in the 400 mg group, and 11 (33%) in the 1400 mg group had a PSA response at 12 weeks.
the median metastasis-free survival was 40.4 months with darolutamide, as compared with 18.4 months with placebo

added_models.model: Mouse brain:plasma distribution with rat and dog CNS toxicology (darolutamide)

safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; brain:plasma ratio and rat/dog CNS data from the FDA review of NDA 212099. First-use year proxied by first publication; the studies ran under IND 114769 (from 2011).
safety.judgement: A prediction of absence of a harm the species can show (dog convulsions occurred with apalutamide), so silence is scoreable.
safety.note: Mouse brain:plasma ratio 0.02 and no CNS signs in rats and dogs up to 46 µM predicted no seizure liability, unlike other AR antagonists.
safety.short: Low brain exposure predicts no seizures
safety.quote: In contrast to other antiandrogens, ODM-201 shows negligible brain penetrance and does not increase serum testosterone levels in mice.

safety.confidence_note: Full-text FDA review read from the source bundle.
safety.judgement: The review sets preclinical and clinical seizure data side by side, so comparison_stated true. Distinct from the draft's apalutamide dog/GABA-A track, which predicted the harm; this one predicted its absence.
safety.note: ARAMIS: seizures 0.2% on darolutamide and 0.2% on placebo; none of 12 patients with prior seizures had one.
safety.quote: In pre-clinical and clinical trials of darolutamide, there was no indication of increased seizure potential which may be attributed to its structure and low penetration of the blood brain barrier.
safety.reason: Predicted no seizure excess; none seen

added_models.model: ARN-509/enzalutamide-resistant cell lines and AR F876L xenografts

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. Model first use proxied by publication; it first appears in the same paper that carries the comparison.
efficacy.judgement: Patient-level prediction: which patients stop responding (F876L carriers). Opener at first use, per rule 6.
efficacy.note: Cell lines grown resistant to apalutamide (ARN-509) carried AR F876L, which turns the drug into an agonist; F876L tumours resisted in vivo.
efficacy.quote: AR F876L is sufficient to confer resistance to ARN-509 and enzalutamide in in vitro and in vivo models of castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC).

efficacy.magnitude_basis: presence of F876L in plasma DNA at progression
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. Rathkopf 2017 (doi:10.1093/annonc/mdx283, NCT01171898) found acquired F877L in only 3/82 patients at progression and called LBD mutations 'not common contributors' to apalutamide resistance.
efficacy.judgement: Not a retrodiction: the mutation came from the cell lines and was then looked for in patient plasma. Direction held (carriers progressed), but Rathkopf 2017 shows F876L explains little resistance; kept same, not contra, since the model predicted resistance in carriers, not its frequency.
efficacy.note: The predicted F876L mutation was found in plasma DNA of apalutamide-treated patients whose CRPC progressed (ARN-509-001).
efficacy.quote: Importantly, the AR F876L mutant is detected in plasma DNA from ARN-509-treated patients with progressive CRPC.

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; the xenograft cell line was not verified. Trial result is tier 5 only (Kintor 2021 annual-results release: IDMC found interim rPFS not significant); no final rPFS/OS report found.
efficacy.judgement: Left untested: the xenograft was NHA-naive castration-resistant disease while the phase 3 enrolled patients progressing after abiraterone/enzalutamide, and only an interim miss of a co-primary endpoint is public. The phase 1 in the same paper had safety/PK as primary objective.
efficacy.note: Proxalutamide inhibited castration-resistant xenograft growth. Its 2L+ mCRPC phase 3 missed interim rPFS (Kintor, Sept 2020); population never modelled.
efficacy.quote: The efficacy of GT0918 was investigated in a castration-resistant xenograft model.

considered_not_added: Rezvilutamide (SHR3680): no published in-vivo or in-vitro model found; CHART is positive but has nothing to pair with.
TRC-253 (JNJ-63576253) F877L xenografts (Branch 2021 MCT): phase 1/2a primary endpoint was DLT, so no efficacy comparison; not searched further.
Darolutamide in-vitro activity against F876L and other AR LBD mutants (Moilanen 2015): no patient study selecting or reading out by mutation found.
Darolutamide VCaP model in the dose cell: the 600 mg bid dose came from ARADES dose ranging, and no source compares a xenograft exposure target with human exposure.
Patient-derived organoids, PDX co-clinical trials, explants: found only for enzalutamide (outside the member list) or with no patient comparison for a member drug.
QSP / PK-PD models for dose: none found for member drugs that predate the dose choice; apalutamide population PK is patient data, not a model of the prediction.
Human genetic model (androgen insensitivity): not a model of prostate cancer response; no comparison.
AR-V7 in circulating tumour cells: a patient biomarker, not a model system, and the key studies are on enzalutamide/abiraterone.
